name: cosmic-context
description: COSMIC project context: project background, overview, module tree (up to 3 levels with abbreviation codes), roles (person/organization/system), third-party systems, ID conventions, and design principles; generated from materials, with model-assumed items explicitly registered (root pack, no upstream consumed).

moduleLevels.description: Depth of the module tree (1-3): the artifact's actual tree depth must equal it (rule context/module-depth), and moduleIdConventionForLevel1..N must be declared for every level in use; shared with cosmic-plan via receipt inheritance
